text:
sre_oncall: FYI incident follow-up: yesterday's cross-region error — us-west LB routing bug + TLS handshake failures caused retries to eu-west and a spike in 5xx. Mitigated via emergency route-priority rollback, but we need a permanent fix. Starting list of action items below. Please ack and claim.

netops_lead: Ack. I'll take ownership of the LB routing fix and the canary plan. ETA ~2 weeks. Will coordinate with ops_infra for rollout windows.

maria_dev: I'll add TLS handshake diagnostic logs and correlation IDs to make the TLS failures reproducible. ETA 3 days.

alex_m: Can platform_pm confirm if Dedicated customers were impacted? We need to prepare targeted comms if so.

platform_pm: Some Dedicated tenants in us-west saw elevated latencies but no data loss. I'll draft a comms note by EOD tomorrow and loop legal for review.

ops_infra: I'll prototype a cross-region retry throttling guard to prevent retry amplification during route flaps. ETA 5 days.

sre_oncall: Recurring pattern note: we observed a similar flake on 2024-11-12 after a route-priority change — seems like configuration drift + missing preflight checks. netops_lead please include automated config-diff alerts in remediation.

netops_lead: Will add config-diff + automated validation tests to the route-change pipeline. Also proposing a rollback guard: require a two-person approval for priority-affecting route changes.

maria_dev: Proposed log snippet to add:
```
level=debug component=tls handshake_err="%v" client_cert_subject=%s route=%s correlation_id=%s
```
This will help correlate client retries across regions.

sre-bot: Postmortem draft created: https://confluence.internal/redwood/incidents/CR-2026-042 — owners auto-added from thread.

alex_m: :thumbsup: Also suggest weekly recurrence checks for the next 4 weeks and a follow-up review after the fixes land.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: netops/route-fix v1.1 -> staging at 23:15 UTC today. Please review PR.

netops_lead: v1.1 includes the priority fix, config-diff, and the approval guard. Opening PR now for review and will ping the release channel when merged.

sre_oncall: Action items summary (tl;dr):
1) netops_lead — LB routing fix + config guard — ETA 2w
2) ops_infra — cross-region retry throttling — ETA 5d
3) maria_dev — TLS logs + test harness — ETA 3d
4) platform_pm — comms draft & legal loop — EOD tomorrow
I'll run weekly recurrence scans and report back in this thread. Re-open if any timelines slip or new incidents appear.

maria_dev: Ack. I'll post a short test plan + link to the PR after pushing the log changes.

netops_lead: Moving rollout discussion to #eng-releases for scheduling. Will ping here when merged and when we start canary.

platform_pm: Will coordinate customer comms and update the status page draft.

sre_oncall: Marking this thread as the official follow-up tracker. Ping @sre_oncall if blocking issues come up.

alex_m: Note: also check LB healthcheck jitter thresholds — they might be contributing to transient failovers.

ops_infra: Added a staging alert for healthcheck jitter > 10% and increased tolerance in test env. Will monitor.

sre_oncall: Thanks everyone — closing for now but will post updates in this thread as work progresses. :white_check_mark:
